name: Twitch
description: A front page like twitch.tv: featured streams, popular streams in your language, top categories and a row per big category. Twitch categories and channels in search, live chat, and streams that play in sync for everyone.
requires: Internet access from the server to twitch.tv. No Twitch account needed.

settings.label: Your channels (shown first when they are live)
settings.help: Twitch names separated by commas, e.g. "lofigirl, xqc".

settings.label: Extra row for a language
settings.help: "auto" = the TV's language (no extra row for English), a language code such as "sv", or empty for no such row.

settings.label: Rows for the biggest categories
settings.help: A row of streams for each of the biggest categories, e.g. Just Chatting (0–6).
